name: Aniventure Comic Con
blurb: Bulgaria's major comic convention in Sofia, mixing film and TV guests with anime, manga, cosplay and gaming at the Inter Expo Center.

editions.evidence: Official og:image on comiccon.bg (uploaded to the site's 2026/07 media folder, i.e. just after the 2026 show) reads '10-11 ЮЛИ 2027 INTER EXPO CENTER'; independent listings (cypruscomiccon.org, onhuddle.co, go-sofia.com) all cite 'Aniventure Comic Con 2027 ... 10-11 July 2027' at Inter Expo Center, Sofia.

notes: The live homepage body text, nav countdown and guests page (https://comiccon.bg/en/special-guests/) still describe the 2026-07-11/12 edition in detail (specific panel times, a wrestling show, guests Christopher Judge, John Rhys-Davies, Oona Chaplin, etc.) even though that edition has already happened before today (2026-10-05); that lineup belongs to the past show, not the next one, so it is not recorded here. Only the site's own dated og:image and third-party event listings confirm the next edition (2027-07-10/11); the guest/guests page has not been updated for it yet, hence guests=none-yet. A sibling domain aniventure.net mirrors the same (also-stale) 2026 content; comiccon.bg is used as the canonical url since it matches the given seed and carries the dated 2027 key art.
